purpose_of_file: Instructions for Claude Code: what to build with, in what order, and what security gates every change must pass.

version_policy.rule: Every version below marked PIN_AT_INIT must be resolved to an exact version and hash at project init, then locked (Cargo.lock, go.sum, pubspec.lock). No ranges, no 'latest'.
version_policy.updates: Dependency updates only by explicit user approval, one PR per update, with audit gates re-run.

build_order.name: frontend
build_order.rule: Claude Code does not design or build the frontend unless Ronin explicitly asks. Backend exposes a stable, documented API for it.

rust.name: rustls
rust.use: TLS; use a FIPS-capable crypto provider

rust.name: aws-lc-rs
rust.use: crypto provider with a FIPS 140-3 validated mode

rust.name: zeroize
rust.use: wipe secrets from memory after use

go.name: standard library net/http
go.use: local REST API bound to 127.0.0.1 only

system.name: libpcap
system.use: capture library under tcpdump and tshark

system.name: tshark (Wireshark CLI)
system.use: protocol dissection backend, phase B integration

dependency_audit: dart pub outdated + osv-scanner on pubspec.lock
fuzzing: go test -fuzz on API input handlers

mitigations: forbid unsafe outside a reviewed FFI module
vendor dependencies for offline reproducible builds
no new dependency without user approval
capture via CAP_NET_RAW/CAP_BPF on capture binary only
LLM read-only access to log files
commercial API off by default, redacted summaries only, user opt-in

smoke_tests.rule: Run on every build. Any failure blocks merge.
tests: binaries build reproducibly (two builds, identical hashes)
all audit tools report zero unresolved high/critical issues
capture engine starts without root and captures loopback traffic
REST API refuses connections from non-127.0.0.1 addresses
LLM sandbox cannot open network sockets or write files
FIPS mode toggle works from config alone
log export round-trips and its signature verifies

weekly: osv-scanner against lockfiles for new advisories

capture_integration_roadmap.work: Rust engine on libpcap; flows, DNS, TLS SNI; plain-English summaries
adapters that run tcpdump and tshark as unprivileged subprocesses and parse their output (tshark -T json/ek); same log schema
eBPF via aya to tag each flow with its process and systemd unit; evaluate ptcpdump

capture_integration_roadmap.goal: deep inspection of the user's own HTTPS
capture_integration_roadmap.work: optional mitmproxy integration, user-installed CA, off by default, clear warnings
optional Zeek integration for richer protocol logs
